audit_items.proof_trace: `ObligationOwnerCap has key, store` carries no `copy` ability, so the Move bytecode verifier rejects any duplication at the VM level. The only constructor (`new()`) is `public(package)`, preventing external modules from forging a struct literal; each cap receives a globally-unique UID via `object::new(ctx)`, guaranteeing uniqueness. All three claims of the assumption — `is_unique`, `cannot_be_copied`, `cannot_be_forged` — are fully enforced by the Move type system and module privacy model.
